title: 보일러
scene: 한겨울 밤, 집에 혼자 있는 학습자. 방이 너무 춥다. 도윤에게 카톡
goal: Asking for help with the Korean floor heating

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Doyun, my room is freezing ㅠㅠ

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Did you turn on the boiler?

turns.speaker: B
turns.en: Whoa… you haven't used the boiler for three months?
turns.note: Kick: three months in the cold

turns.speaker: A
turns.ko: 난 그냥 이불 세 개 덮었는데…
turns.rd: nan geunyang ibul se gae deopeonneunde…

turns.speaker: B
turns.ko: ㅋㅋㅋ 부엌 옆에 버튼 있어. 「난방」 눌러.
turns.rd: ㅋㅋㅋ bueok yeope beoteun isseo. 「nanbang」 nulleo.
turns.en: Lolol there's a button by the kitchen. Press "heating".

turns.speaker: A
turns.en: Wait… whoa, the floor is warm!

turns.speaker: B
turns.ko: 한국 겨울은 바닥이야. 이제 이불 하나만 덮어.
turns.rd: hanguk gyeoureun badagiya. ije ibul hanaman deopeo.
turns.en: Korean winter is all about the floor. Now just one blanket.
